info.title: OpenType API
info.description: The OpenType HTTP API: decision runs on Neon 1.1, API keys, usage, quota and billing. Every `/v1` route takes `Authorization: Bearer <credential>`, where the credential is an API key (`otsk_` followed by 64 hex characters) or a console session token. Amounts are integers in micro-USD (1,000,000 = 1 US dollar). Errors share one envelope, `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`. Stripe is named only where it hosts checkout, the billing portal and receipts.

get.description: Public and unauthenticated. Answers `200` while the API process is up. It says nothing about dependencies; use `GET /readyz` for that.
Public and unauthenticated. Answers `200` with `status: "ok"` when every dependency needed to serve traffic is ready, and `503` with `status: "unavailable"` otherwise.

post.description:
Submits a run and returns its answer. The call is synchronous: it returns once the run has settled. Requires `runs_write`.

Neon 1.1 serves decision runs (`"kind": "decision"`). A verdict run currently answers `503 no_route_available`.

`Idempotency-Key` is required. Replaying a key with the same body returns the stored run with `replayed: true` and never charges again: `200` when the stored run is terminal (a failed run replays as `200` with `state: "failed"`), `202` when it is still `pending`. The same key with a different body is `409 idempotency_conflict`. Keys are scoped to your organization and never expire. After a `5xx` or `504`, retry with a new key.

While it runs, a run holds its whole spend ceiling (at most 5,000 micro-USD) against your credit and quota; settlement charges the actual cost. See [Errors](/reference/errors) for every refusal.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 255 bytes of visible ASCII text, unique per logical request. Reuse it only to retry the same body.

state.ticket: I was charged twice this month and nobody answers my emails.

200.description: The settled run: a fresh run, or the replay of a terminal run (`replayed: true`).

202.description: The replay of a run that is still `pending`. Send the request again with a new `Idempotency-Key`.

401.description: `missing_credentials` (no bearer credential) or `invalid_credential` (malformed, unknown or revoked).

402.description: `insufficient_credits`: your available credit does not cover the run's hold. Buy credit or enable auto-recharge; the same key is reusable.

403.description: `scope_denied`: the credential lacks `runs_write`. A session without an organization gets `no_active_organization`.

409.description: `idempotency_conflict`: this key was already used with a different body.

413.description: `body_too_large` (over 1 MiB) or `input_too_large` (the input estimate is over 64,000 tokens, or over the 3,968-token Neon 1.1 context).

429.description: `organization_spend_quota_exhausted` or `organization_token_quota_exhausted`: the quota for this period cannot cover the run. The same key is reusable.

503.description: The run could not be served: `no_route_available`, `decision_unavailable`, `budget_exhausted`, `verdict_schema_violation` (with `violations`), `catalog_unavailable`, `not_configured`, `database_unavailable`, `provider_unauthorized`, `provider_rate_limited`, `provider_rejected_request`, `provider_unavailable` or `provider_malformed_response`. Also `auth_not_configured` or `trust_keys_unavailable` when credentials cannot be verified.

get.description:
Lists your organization's runs, newest first. Requires `runs_read`.

Rows are stored runs: each carries `replayed: true` and no `verdict`, `decision`, `usage` or cost. Retrieve a run for its answer. Paging is by `limit` and `offset`; there is no cursor. See [Pagination](/guides/pagination).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20. Out-of-range values are clamped: 0 becomes 1, 500 becomes 100.

200.description: A page of runs. `limit` and `offset` echo the values applied.

400.description: `invalid_body`: `limit` or `offset` is not a whole number, or another query parameter was sent.

401.description: `missing_credentials` (no bearer credential) or `invalid_credential` (malformed, unknown or revoked).

403.description: `scope_denied`: the credential lacks `runs_read`. A session without an organization gets `no_active_organization`.

503.description: `database_unavailable` or `not_configured`. Also `auth_not_configured` or `trust_keys_unavailable` when credentials cannot be verified.

get.description:
Reads one run from stored state. Requires `runs_read`. Never calls the model, so reading a run is free.

A completed run carries its `verdict` or `decision`, plus `usage` and `cost_micros`. Stored reads omit `cost_basis` and `schema_enforcement`, and a stored decision omits `model`, `stages` and the thought fields. A run that is not completed returns the run without an answer.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: `run_` followed by 32 hex characters, as the API returns it. The hyphenated form the usage routes return is also accepted.

401.description: `missing_credentials` (no bearer credential) or `invalid_credential` (malformed, unknown or revoked).

403.description: `scope_denied`: the credential lacks `runs_read`. A session without an organization gets `no_active_organization`.

404.description: `run_not_found`: no run with this id in your organization.

get.description:
Returns the run's stored state as server-sent events, then closes. Requires `runs_read`. Never calls the model, so it cannot charge.

The body is one snapshot: a `state` event (`{run_id, state}`), then, only when the run is `completed` or `failed`, a `terminal` event with `run_id`, `state`, `input_digest` and `output_digest` (possibly `null`). A completed run's `terminal` event adds `kind` and the whole `verdict` or `decision`. There are no partial-answer events, no `id:` or `retry:` fields, and `Last-Event-ID` is not read. The stream does not wait for a `pending` run: request it again, or poll `GET /v1/runs/{run_id}`. Errors before the stream starts are JSON. See [Streaming](/guides/streaming).

post.description:
Creates a key and returns its secret once, in `secret`. Store it now: no other response carries it, and a lost secret is rotated, not recovered.

Requires `keys_write`; a `service_account` principal also needs `members_write`. Every requested scope must be one the caller holds. Scopes are sorted, deduplicated and fixed at creation. Keys do not expire. See [API keys](/console/api-keys).

Revokes a key. It stops authenticating immediately. Requires `keys_write`.

Idempotent: revoking a revoked key returns `200` with the original `revoked_at`. A revoked key is never deleted; it stays in the list with `state: "revoked"`.

post.description:
Issues a new secret for the same key `id`, name and scopes, and returns it once. Requires `keys_write`.

The old secret stops working immediately; there is no overlap window. A revoked key cannot be rotated. See [Key rotation](/guides/key-rotation).

get.description:
Run counts, tokens and spend for your organization over a window. Requires `usage_read`.

The window is half-open, `[start_at, end_at)`, and counts runs created inside it. Omit both bounds for the current UTC calendar month.

parameters.name: start_at
parameters.description: Window start, exactly `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (UTC), inclusive. Send it with `end_at`; omit both for the current UTC calendar month.

parameters.name: end_at
parameters.description: Window end, exactly `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (UTC), exclusive. Send it with `start_at`.

400.description: `invalid_parameter`: a malformed window, `start_at` not before `end_at`, or one bound without the other. An unknown query parameter gets a plain-text `400`.

401.description: `missing_credentials` (no bearer credential) or `invalid_credential` (malformed, unknown or revoked).

403.description: `scope_denied`: the credential lacks `usage_read`. A session without an organization gets `no_active_organization`.

503.description: `database_not_configured` or `database_unavailable`: accounting storage is unavailable. Also `auth_not_configured` or `trust_keys_unavailable` when credentials cannot be verified.

get.description:
One row per UTC day: runs created that day, their tokens and their spend. Requires `usage_read`.

Rows run from the start date through the day of the last instant before `end_at`, oldest first. Days without activity are present at zero. The window spans at most 92 days; omit both bounds for the current UTC calendar month.

parameters.name: start_at
parameters.description: Window start, exactly `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (UTC), inclusive. Send it with `end_at`; omit both for the current UTC calendar month.

parameters.name: end_at
parameters.description: Window end, exactly `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (UTC), exclusive. Send it with `start_at`. At most 92 days after `start_at`.

400.description: `invalid_parameter`: a malformed window, `start_at` not before `end_at`, one bound without the other, or a window over 92 days. An unknown query parameter gets a plain-text `400`.

401.description: `missing_credentials` (no bearer credential) or `invalid_credential` (malformed, unknown or revoked).

get.description:
The spend and token ledger: one entry per model attempt, newest first. Requires `usage_read`.

The window filters on when each attempt was recorded. There is no offset: narrow the window to read further back.

parameters.name: start_at
parameters.description: Window start, exactly `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (UTC), inclusive. Send it with `end_at`; omit both for the current UTC calendar month.

parameters.name: end_at
parameters.description: Window end, exactly `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (UTC), exclusive. Send it with `start_at`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Entries to return. Defaults to 50; values above 200 are clamped to 200. `0` is refused.

400.description: `invalid_parameter`: a malformed window, one bound without the other, or `limit=0`. An unknown query parameter gets a plain-text `400`.

post.description:
Creates a Stripe Checkout page for a credit purchase and returns its URL. Requires `billing_write`.

`amount_micros` is $5 to $1,000 in whole cents. Paying saves the card for auto-recharge, and both success and cancel return to the console's billing page. The credit is added once the payment is confirmed, not by this response. Returns `200`, not `201`.

200.description: Where to send the user to pay.

400.description: `invalid_amount`: outside 5,000,000 to 1,000,000,000, or not a whole number of cents. Malformed JSON gets a plain-text `400`.

401.description: `missing_credentials` (no bearer credential) or `invalid_credential` (malformed, unknown or revoked).

403.description: `scope_denied`: the credential lacks `billing_write`. A session without an organization gets `no_active_organization`.

413.description: The body is over 1 MiB. Plain-text body.

422.description: An unknown field, a wrong type or a missing required field. Plain-text body.

post.description: Returns a URL to the Stripe billing portal, where you manage saved cards and download receipts and invoices. It returns to the console's billing page. Requires `billing_write`. Takes no body.

401.description: `missing_credentials` (no bearer credential) or `invalid_credential` (malformed, unknown or revoked).

403.description: `scope_denied`: the credential lacks `billing_write`. A session without an organization gets `no_active_organization`.

put.description:
Stores auto-recharge settings and returns the updated billing state. Requires `billing_write`.

When enabled, and a card is saved, the server checks after each run admission and after each `402`: if the available balance is below `threshold_micros`, it charges `amount_micros` to the saved card, at most once per organization per clock hour. The credit lands when the payment succeeds. See [Auto-recharge](/guides/auto-recharge).

400.description: `invalid_amount`: `amount_micros` outside the checkout bounds, `threshold_micros` above 1,000,000,000, or either number missing while `enabled` is `true`. Malformed JSON gets a plain-text `400`.

401.description: `missing_credentials` (no bearer credential) or `invalid_credential` (malformed, unknown or revoked).

403.description: `scope_denied`: the credential lacks `billing_write`. A session without an organization gets `no_active_organization`.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Create, list, retrieve and stream runs.

tags.description: Usage rollups, the daily series, the ledger and quota.

tags.description: Credit balance, checkout, the billing portal and auto-recharge.

bearer.description: An API key (otsk_ + 64 hex) or a console session token.

amount_micros.description: Required when `enabled` is `true`. 5,000,000 to 1,000,000,000, in whole cents.

AutoRechargeRequest.description: Auto-recharge settings. Unknown fields are refused.

threshold_micros.description: Recharge when the available balance falls below this. May be `null`.

amount_micros.description: How much to buy. May be `null`.

balance_micros.description: Signed. Credits, minus settled spend, minus what unsettled runs hold.

has_payment_method.description: Whether a card is saved for auto-recharge.

id.description: `txn_` followed by 32 hex characters, or `txn_usage_YYYYMMDD` for one day's usage.

amount_micros.description: Signed: positive adds credit, negative spends it.

created_at.description: A usage row is dated 00:00:00Z of its day.

CapabilityHint.description: A routing capability. A hint can only narrow the routes considered.

CheckoutRequest.description: A credit purchase. Unknown fields are refused.

checkout_url.description: A Stripe-hosted checkout page. Send the user there to pay.

CostBasis.description: `provider_reported`: the usage the model reported. `estimated`: the pre-call estimate at list prices.

name.description: A label shown in the console. Not unique.

scopes.description: At least one scope, each held by the caller.

principal.description: Who the key acts as. Omit it to act as yourself. A `service_account` needs `members_write`; another user's id is `403 principal_is_not_the_caller`.

CreateKeyRequest.description: A new key. Unknown fields are refused.

kind.description: `decision` or `verdict`. Defaults to `verdict`, so send `decision` explicitly for a decision run.

model.description: Decision runs only. `neon-1.1`, or `neon-latest`, which resolves to `neon-1.1`. Any other value is `400 unknown_model`.

system.description: Verdict runs only. A system prompt.

messages.description: Verdict runs only, and required for them. At least one prompt turn.

schema.description: Verdict runs only, and required for them. The JSON Schema the verdict must satisfy: an object of at most 32 KiB, nesting depth 12, 64 subschemas and 512 properties, `pattern` values of at most 256 characters, and only local `#` references. Out of bounds is `400 invalid_verdict_schema`.

state.description: Decision runs only, and required for them. What is being decided about: any JSON value. A string is sent as-is; anything else as its JSON text.

instructions.description: Decision runs only. Context that applies to every question.

questions.description: Decision runs only, and required for them. 1 to 64 questions keyed by your own ids. An id must be non-empty and must not contain `:` or a newline. Out of bounds is `400 invalid_decision_questions`.

draws.description: Decision runs only. Independent reads to average, 1 to 8. Defaults to 1.

think_tokens.description: Decision runs only. Tokens the model may think before answering, 0 to 4096. Defaults to 0. The thought text is never returned.

capability_hint.description: Optional routing hints. At most 7, no duplicates. Hints can only narrow routing. Hint errors are reported as `invalid_verdict_schema` on either kind.

max_output_tokens.description: Required. Output tokens the run may generate, greater than 0. Counts toward the token quota estimate.

deadline_ms.description: Time budget in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000. Clamped to 1 to 120000. Past it the run is `504 deadline_exceeded`.

question_order.description: Decision runs only. Your question order; it must name exactly the keys of `questions`. Defaults to sorted key order.

CreateRunRequest.description: A run. `kind` selects a decision (`state` plus `questions`) or a verdict (`messages` plus `schema`), and defaults to `verdict`. `max_output_tokens` is required on every run. Unknown fields are refused, and a field that belongs to the other kind is `400 invalid_body`.

spend_micros.description: Attempt cost of those runs, in micro-USD.

days.description: One row per UTC day, oldest first. Days without activity are present at zero.

criteria.description: Optional descriptions of what `true` and `false` mean.

oneOf.title: noul
oneOf.description: A yes/no question. Its answer names are `yes` and `no`; the answer's `probability` is P(yes).

criteria.description: Option name to an optional description, or `null`.

oneOf.title: choice
oneOf.description: A closed option set. The option names are the answer names.

oneOf.title: score
oneOf.description: Ordered levels. Answers are keyed by 0-based level index.

DecisionQuestionRequest.description: One question, selected by `type`: `noul` (yes or no), `choice` (a closed option set) or `score` (ordered levels). Each needs 2 to 20 alternatives with unique names; `noul` always has 2. Unknown keys are refused.

answers.description: One answer per question, keyed by your question ids. Shapes by `type`: `noul` has `probability`, which is P(yes); `choice` has `choice`, `probabilities` keyed by option name, and `confidence`; `score` has `score` (the expected 0-based level index), `legend`, `probabilities` keyed by index, and `confidence`; `skipped` has `because` (`question`, `answered` when known, `required`) when an `ask_if` failed. Any answer may carry `label_mass` and `answered_within_labels`. Every probability and confidence is between 0 and 1.

read.description: What constrained the answers. Only `slot_constrained` is produced today.

model.description: Live responses only. The model that served the run: `neon-1.1`.

stages.description: Live responses only. Question ids per stage, in the order the stages ran.

thought_tokens.description: Live responses only, when thought tokens were generated. The thought text is never returned.

ErrorBody.description: The error envelope, shared by every route. Branch on `error.code`.

code.description: Stable snake_case code. The only field to branch on.

message.description: For people. It may change, and it never contains model output.

request_id.description: The request id, also sent in the `x-request-id` response header. Quote it when you report a problem.

violations.description: Only on `verdict_schema_violation`: up to 10 JSON Pointers into the rejected document.

service.description: An opaque label. Do not depend on its value.

id.description: An id you choose for the service account.

KeyPrincipal.description: Who a key acts as: a user, or a service account owned by the organization.

id.description: `key_` followed by 32 hex characters. Not a secret; this is what goes in URLs.

secret_prefix.description: The first 13 characters of the secret (`otsk_` plus 8), for display.

last_used_at.description: Best effort, updated at most about once a minute. `null` until first use.

KeyState.description: A revoked key is kept, never deleted.

KeyWithSecretResponse.description: A key with its secret. Only create and rotate return this.

run_id.description: The run, in hyphenated form (`run_xxxxxxxx-xxxx-...`). Both run id forms are accepted everywhere.

retry_ordinal.description: The attempt's position within its run.

cost_micros.description: Cost of this attempt in micro-USD.

entries.description: One per model attempt, newest first.

NoulCriteria.description: What each side of a yes/no question means. Both are optional.

portal_url.description: The Stripe billing portal for your organization.

request_spend_ceiling_micros.description: The per-run spend ceiling, at most 5,000 micro-USD. Each run holds this much until it settles.

remaining_spend_micros.description: The spend limit minus the larger of settled and reserved spend, floored at 0. `null` when there is no spend limit.

remaining_tokens.description: The token limit minus total tokens, floored at 0. `null` when there is no token limit.

RunKind.description: `decision`: probabilities over closed answer sets. `verdict`: one JSON document validated against your schema.

runs.description: Stored runs, newest first, without answers, usage or cost.

limit.description: The limit applied, after clamping to 1 to 100.

RunMessage.description: One prompt turn. Unknown keys are refused.

state.description: `pending` until the run settles, then `completed` or `failed`.

input_digest.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 of the normalized input, kind and contract.

output_digest.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 of the output, when the run produced one.

verdict.description: Completed verdict runs: your JSON document, validated against your schema.

usage.description: Input and output tokens, when known.

cost_basis.description: Live responses only. `provider_reported`, or `estimated` when no usage was reported, a decision ran with `draws` above 1, or the price could no longer be resolved.

schema_enforcement.description: Live verdict responses only. What bound the answer.

replayed.description: `true` whenever the body came from storage: every replay, retrieve, stream and list row. A replay is never charged again.

RunResponse.description: A run. A completed run carries `verdict` or `decision`, never both. Absent optional fields are omitted, not `null`. Stored reads (replays, retrieve, stream, list rows) omit `cost_basis` and `schema_enforcement`; list rows also omit the answer, `usage` and cost.

RunStateResponse.description: `pending` until the run settles, then `completed` or `failed`.

ceiling_micros.description: This run's spend ceiling, at most 5,000 micro-USD.

SchemaEnforcementResponse.description: `unconstrained`: only the server's own validation bound the answer. `requested`: the schema was offered to the model but did not bind it. `forced`: the model was compelled into the schema slot, unchecked upstream. `enforced`: decoding was constrained to the schema. Every returned verdict passed validation, whatever this says.

Scope.description: A permission a key or session holds.

depends_on.description: Ids of other questions in this set that must be answered in an earlier stage. Cycles are refused.

ask_if.description: Question id to the answer names that make this question worth asking. When the condition fails, the answer is `skipped`.

alone.description: Read this question on its own rather than jointly with its stage.

SharedQuestionFields.description: Optional fields every question type accepts.

reserved_micros.description: Per run, the larger of its hold and its cost while the hold is in place; otherwise its cost.

UsageWindowBody.description: A half-open UTC window, `[start_at, end_at)`, in `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` form.
